one_liner: Open-source command-line tool (mmdc) to render Mermaid diagrams to SVG/PNG/PDF and to transform Markdown containing Mermaid code.
access_notes: No developer credential flow because there’s no remote API; installation is via npm or Docker per the docs.
mcp_notes: Official Mermaid MCP Server by Mermaid (mermaid.ai). Docs: https://mermaid.ai/docs/ai/mcp-server and support article: https://mermaid-25331.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51112817195923-Mermaid-MCP-Server . Hosted backend with authentication to Mermaid accounts.
blocker_notes: No hosted/public API; this is a local CLI/library tool only.

evidence.quote: This is a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid. It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.
It’s possible to call mermaid-cli via a Node.JS API.
mermaid CLI has been moved to mermaid-cli. Please read its documentation instead.

The Mermaid MCP Server is an AI integration that lets AI assistants… generate, validate, and render Mermaid diagrams… [It is] a hosted backend… With authentication: saves the diagram directly to your Mermaid account.

_trail.quote: "The Mermaid MCP Server enables AI assistants to create, validate, and render Mermaid diagrams..."
